newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS/STANDINGS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP RESULTS/STANDINGS.

text.p: union matches played in South Africa at the weekend:
In Bloemfontein: Free State beat Eastern Province 75-19
Free State - Tries: Stephen Brink (2), Werner Swanepoel (2),
Braam Els, MJ Smith, Naka Drotske, Johan Erasmus, Charl Marais,
Brendan Venter, Christo Potgieter. Conversions: MJ Smith (7).
Eastern Province - Tries: Deon Kayser, Barry Pinnock.
In Kimberley: Natal beat Griqualand West 24-13 (half-time
Natal - Tries: Shaun Payne, Dieter Kriese. Conversion: Gavin
Griqualand West - Try: Hakkies Husselman. Conversion: Franco
In Brakpan: Gauteng Falcons beat Northern Transvaal 26-23
Gauteng Falcons - Tries: Jaco Viljoen, Gert Peens.
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Conrad Breytenbach, Johan
Schutte (2). Conversion: Casper Steyn. Penalties: Steyn (2)
In Welkom: Western Province beat Northern Free State 43-24
Western Province - Tries: James Small (2), Dick Muir,
Christian Stewart, Andy Marinos, Louis Koen. Conversions: Louis
Northern Free State - Tries: Eric Herbert, Banai Britz (2).
In Wellington: Boland beat North West 54-23 (half-time
Boland - Tries: Stefan Terblanche (3), Martin Stander (2),
Johan van der Merwe, McNeil Hendricks, Harold Karele.
North West - Tries: Andrew Duckitt, AC Prinsloo.
In East London: South Western Districts beat Border 20-16
South Western Districts - Tries: Charles Nel, Freddie
Roberts. Conversions: Braam van Straaten (2). Penalties: Van
Border - Try: David Maidza. Conversion: John Bradbrook.
In Johannesburg: Gauteng Lions beat Mpumalanga 27-26
Gauteng Lions - Tries: Johan Roux (2), Louis van Rensburg.
Conversions: Dawie du Toit, Johan Roux (2). Penalties: Johan
Mpumalanga - Tries: Polla Nel, Piet Joubert, Henry Kemp.
Conversion: Andries Fourie. Penalties: Eben von Gericke (2).
